description: This file is a PHP script for rendering the detailed view of an Invoice in a CRM system, specifically SugarCRM or a derivative. It sets up the environment, retrieves invoice data, checks permissions, and prepares data for display using Smarty templates.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class for CRM entities, providing methods like getInstance and retrieve_entity_info.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper customized for vtiger CRM.

classes.name: Vtiger_Link
classes.description: Class for handling custom links in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Fetches update information for the record.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves display blocks for the detail view.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceNumber
methods.description: Gets the sequence number for the module record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence field for the module, if any.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Returns the parent tab/category of the module.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for actions on records.

methods.name: getDetailAssociatedProducts
methods.description: Fetches products associated with the invoice.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks the status of buttons for the module.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for a module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves validation data for database fields.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if related lists are present for the module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Retrieves related lists for the module.

methods.name: RelatedListViewSession::addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the session for display.

methods.name: Vtiger_Link::getAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves all links of specified types for a module.
